data.value: Your fertilisers, stimulants, silica and anything else that goes in the water, each with the dose you usually use. Logging a feed fills the dose in, and you can change it for that one time. A care entry keeps the name and dose it was logged with, so editing a product here doesn't change what you've already logged.
